title: Afternoon Edition — Tuesday, 20 October 2026
description: AI chip startup Tenstorrent doubles its valuation in a $1.5 billion raise, the RBA's cash rate hits 4.60% as national home prices slide, Queensland commits $417 million to early Brisbane 2032 Olympic venue works, and the Gold Coast Suns climb into the AFLW top four on a five-game winning streak. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

show.channel_description: A short afternoon news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast.
